title: Tour: hmrmath.life
intro: A short look at hmrmath.life in screenshots of the site itself, with our own words for each one. Nothing here is sent anywhere.

steps.say: Screenshots only, nothing is sent. Why does the universe obey equations? In HMR's account, mathematics is the ordered pattern of thought within a Universal Intelligence, and nature is mathematical because it is made of that ordered thought.
The physicist Eugene Wigner called the usefulness of mathematics in physics unreasonable, and said there is no rational explanation for it. HMR offers one, and labels it as HMR's view.
The page is marked work in progress, and it shows how far along each of its parts is.
